sql: select t.twin_tag, t.live_tag, (t.ended_at is null) as is_open, (select count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks k  where k.captured_at >= t.started_at    and k.captured_at <= coalesce(t.ended_at, now())    and k.market_ticker in (     select market_ticker from live_orders o where o.strategy = t.live_tag and o.created_at >= t.started_at     union     select market_ticker from paper_trades p where p.strategy = t.twin_tag and p.legacy = false and p.created_at >= t.started_at   )) as ticks_loaded from live_paper_twins t order by t.started_at desc
